stories.title: Central Railway Pays Homage to Martyrs of 26/11 Terror Attack at CSMT
stories.summary: Central Railway paid solemn tribute to the brave police officers, police personnel, railway staff and innocent passengers who lost their lives in the dastardly terrorist attack at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) on November 26, 2008.

stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai police have deployed more than 500 personnel at Mahalaxmi Racecourse for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh’s concert on Friday, November 27, following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Officials further said that Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have also swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three, as per PTI.

stories.title: BMC clears 15-year deal with Raymond to turn Worli jetty into helipad
stories.summary: The BMC standing committee has cleared a 15-year public-private partnership (PPP) agreement with Raymond Ltd to convert a jetty built during the Mumbai Coastal Road project into a DGCA-licensed helipad at Worli. The proposal was cleared on Thursday. Located opposite Worli Dairy, the jetty was originally constructed as a temporary facility to transport construction material during the construction of the Coastal Road (South).

stories.title: Bomb threats trigger security checks across Mumbai and Navi Mumbai
stories.summary: Mumbai and Navi Mumbai were put on high alert on Thursday, November 26, after threat emails targeting civic headquarters, courts, Metro stations and singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh's upcoming concert triggered security checks across the two cities on the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks.

stories.title: Mumbai: Smoking dispute sparks attack on passenger aboard Kasara-CSMT slow local
stories.summary: In yet another attack in a moving suburban train , a middle-aged passenger was allegedly attacked in the eye by a few people after he objected to them smoking beedi onboard the Kasara-CSMT slow local train on Friday morning. The victim said that he was travelling towards CSMT in the luggage compartment, and he spotted a group of commuters smoking inside the running train, to which he objected.

stories.title: Thane: Kalwa police seize Rs 94.78 lakh contraband, one arrested
stories.summary: 78 lakh, in an operation near Parsik Circle on the Mumbra-Bhiwandi highway . Officials, while briefing about the operation, said that the container driver has been arrested, while police are searching for seven other accused allegedly involved in the smuggling network.

stories.title: Thane MACT awards Rs 1.1 crore to family of cop killed in 2022 road accident
stories.summary: 1 crore to the family of a 30-year-old police head constable who was killed after a trailer hit his motorcycle while he was on duty in November 2022. Tribunal Member R V Mohite directed the trailer owner and the vehicle's insurance company to jointly and severally pay the compensation, along with interest at 9 per cent per annum from the date of filing the claim petition.

stories.title: Western Railway plans Rs 98 crore Vande Bharat depot at Mumbai's Lower Parel, Dadar to get greater capacity to originate long-distance trains
stories.summary: The proposed facility will come up on around 55,000 square metres of land currently occupied by Central Railway's Store Depot. The project will be executed in two phases, with Rs 49 crore sanctioned for Phase I. The planned infrastructure includes two full-length pit lines, six stabling lines, two sick lines and one shunting neck.

stories.title: Priyanka Chopra pays tribute to victims of 26/11 terror attack in Mumbai, remembers heroes
stories.summary: Actor Priyanka Chopra paid tribute to the ones who lost their lives in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks at the Gateway of India on its 18th anniversary on Thursday. The actor took to her Instagram Stories and wrote, "Remembering the lives lost and the heroes who gave everything on 26/11.

stories.title: BMC to fine pigeon feeders ₹500 at Dadar, Mahim Chowpatty
stories.summary: For residents living around Dadar and Mahim Chowpatty, accumulated pigeon droppings, foul smells and concerns over unhygienic surroundings have become a persistent nuisance. After repeated complaints that open feeding has continued despite the closure of Dadar’s Kabutarkhana, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has now decided to station personnel at both locations to catch offenders and impose a ₹ 500 fine.

stories.title: Two arrested with charas worth ₹12.20 crore at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus in Mumbai
stories.summary: 20 crore from their possession at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT) during an operation conducted on the intervening night of November 24 and 25. A case was registered on November 25 under Sections 8(c), 20(c) and 29 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.

stories.title: Mumbai weather: Mercury touches 35 deg C as city records moderate AQI of 118
stories.summary: Mumbai is likely to experience mainly clear skies on Friday, November 27, with warm and dry weather conditions expected across the city and its adjoining suburbs, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). No rainfall is forecast, and temperatures are expected to remain relatively comfortable during the early morning before rising through the day.

stories.title: Enforcement Directorate moves Bombay High Court challenging order rejecting its plea for custody of ‘fake doctor’ arrested in Rs 200-crore CSR money-laundering case
stories.summary: Enforcement Directorate (ED) has moved Bombay High Court challenging a special court’s order rejecting its plea seeking custody of alleged fake doctor Dharmendra Kumar arrested in a Rs 200-crore corporate social responsibility (CSR) money-laundering case. Kumar had originally been arrested by Mumbai Police in July in the cheating case and was in judicial custody.

stories.title: Illegal Bangladeshi national held from Borivali
stories.summary: A 35-year-old Bangladeshi national; who was living illegally in Mumbai for the past 15 years, was arrested by Borivali Police. On Nov 13, police carried out an inspection at Borivali vegetable market where they apprehended Marion Chandra Rath. Initially, he tried to converse with the police team in broken Marathi but the police went through documents on his mobile phone and were able to confirm his nationality.

stories.title: Gold worth ₹20 crore stolen after gang of 4 intercepts vehicle in Navi Mumbai: Police
stories.summary: Gold ornaments worth ₹ 20 crore were allegedly stolen on Thane-Belapur Road in Maharashtra on Thursday night after four unidentified men intercepted a car carrying the valuables, smashed its windows with iron rods and assaulted its 55-year-old driver before fleeing. 45 pm in Shiravane, along the service road adjoining Thane-Belapur Road.

stories.title: Not just Saurav Das: CJP’s Dipke, Ranka also face Mumbai Police lookout circulars
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars (LoCs) against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das in connection with an FIR registered over the party's allegedly unauthorised protest at Shivaji Park in Dadar on October 2, coinciding with Gandhi Jayanti.

stories.title: Andheri police station gets new in-charge after duty allocation row
stories.summary: Two key personnel have been transferred out of Andheri police station following a controversy involving duty allocation, harassment allegations and a departmental inquiry. stories.title: Mumbai water cut continues on Friday in parts of city, low-pressure supply
stories.summary: Water cuts and low-pressure supply will continue in parts of Mumbai on Friday as the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) carries out pipeline repair work between Powai and Sahar village. stories.title: Mumbai runners and cyclists choked by worsening AQI
stories.summary: Mumbai runners and cyclists are lacing up and hitting the streets again as the monsoon and pre-winter heat give way to cooler mornings. But as the city’s air turns increasingly polluted , the joy and comfort of outdoor exercise comes with a hidden health risk. From breathlessness and throat irritation to declining stamina, fitness enthusiasts say worsening AQI levels are taking a toll on their workouts.

stories.title: Mumbai's green building push gets a boost: 5 new rating systems, Bhutan partnership and green healthcare pact unveiled as Maharashtra accounts For 5.01 billion sqft of green projects

stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), India's richest civic body, is preparing to launch its first-ever municipal bond issue to diversify its funding sources and accelerate infrastructure development across Mumbai. stories.summary: In the Narendra Modi government’s fresh bid to pass the Delimitation Bills, the support of 22 Lok Sabha members from Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) is crucial to achieve the required two-third majority, which it had failed to get in the bill’s last outing in April. stories.summary: Food and grocery delivery major Swiggy is preparing to lay off 340 employees from its quick commerce business, Instamart, as part of a restructuring initiative aimed at supporting its next phase of expansion. stories.title: 'Who's got the mints?': Nathan Lyon named in alleged ball-tampering plot
stories.summary: A report by CODE Sports has identified the veteran spinner as the player who reportedly asked for the sweets during Australia's Test against Pakistan in the UAE. Earlier this week, veteran journalist Gerard Whateley had revealed that an unnamed Australian player had asked, "Who's got the mints?" According to the report, a substitute fielder was then sent to look through the players' bags for red frogs.

stories.title: How John Wright spotted Jasprit Bumrah
stories.summary: The photograph of John Wright alongside Jasprit Bumrah when the duo met in Lincoln, on the outskirts of Christchurch during India A’s match against New Zealand A, that went viral on social media recently may have offered a reminder of the fast bowler’s extraordinary journey.

stories.title: Hasn’t looked dangerous with second new ball: Sunil Gavaskar highlights Jasprit Bumrah's lack of zip
stories.summary: Former India captain Sunil Gavaskar expressed a word of caution regarding Jasprit Bumrah , saying the pacer didn't look threatening with the second new ball on Day 1 of the second Test at Christchurch on Friday. The 32-year-old's pace was relatively down in the final session at the Hagley Oval, with speeds hovering in the 127-130 kmph range.

stories.title: England outclass Aussies again to take series lead
stories.summary: England reaffirmed their advantage over a struggling Australia in white-ball cricket with a seven-wicket thrashing in the third T20 at The Gabba. Fresh from their eight-wicket win on Tuesday, England bowled Australia out for 108 - the lowest total the hosts have been dismissed for in a T20 at home.

stories.title: Twickenham set to be half empty for Nations Championship finals opening night
stories.summary: BBC Sport rugby union news reporter Published 9 minutes ago The start of the Nations Championship finals weekend will play out in front of thousands of empty seats on Friday with Twickenham's Allianz Stadium set to be filled to about half its 82,000-seater capacity. The uppermost tier of the stadium is entirely closed, while just over half of the middle tier is open.

stories.summary: The 15-year-old opener blasted 204 off just 53 balls for India A in an Asia Cup Rising Stars one-day match in Doha on Tuesday, setting new List A records for the fastest century and double century. 2 overs, bouncing back after two low scores in the tournament. "Two matches before he scored the double ton, he hadn't scored and was worried about his performance," coach Manish Ojha said.

stories.title: Eight-time champion Marquez to retire from MotoGP
stories.summary: MotoGP champion Marc Marquez has said he will retire days after clinching a record-equalling eighth title. The 33-year-old Spaniard clinched the 2026 title in Portugal last weekend and will end his professional career after the final race of the season in Valencia. The Ducati rider's latest triumph puts him level with Giacomo Agostini and one clear of modern great Valentino Rossi.

stories.title: Overton runs riot with 5-wicket haul as Australia register lowest-ever home T20I total
stories.summary: In a disheartening performance, Australia limped to just 108 runs in the third T20I against England at the Gabba. Captain Harry Brook's tactical decision to bowl first was validated as Jamie Overton shone with an impressive five-wicket haul. England's bowlers systematically dismantled Australia's batting order, ultimately leading to the team's second-lowest T20I total against their rivals.

stories.title: Mint explainer: why HPV vaccination is critical for girls as India crosses 10 million doses
stories.summary: India has administered more than 10 million doses of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine to 14-year-old girls in less than nine months under a campaign by the Union health ministry. The drive has covered nearly 87% of the annual target cohort of about 12 million girls, drawing praise from the World Health Organization’s (WHO) South-East Asia Region.

stories.title: Can genomics help us understand cancer better? | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Cancer diagnosis is entering a new era, moving beyond identifying the presence of a tumour towards understanding its underlying biology. While conventional diagnostic methods remain fundamental to cancer detection and classification, advances in molecular profiling and genomic testing are helping clinicians uncover the genetic alterations that drive tumour growth, influence disease progression and determine potential responses to treatment.

stories.title: Do Indian bodies burn calories differently? Country’s 1st advanced metabolic chamber seeks answers
stories.summary: The Human Metabolic Chamber at Vellore’s Christian Medical College (CMC) was jointly established by the college and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research’s (TIFR) Advanced Research Unit on Metabolism, Development and Aging (ARUMDA) and is designed to give researchers a more precise picture of how the human body burns calories and uses different sources of energy.

stories.title: Explainer-Spain’s snap election — why it matters and who might win?
stories.summary: MADRID, Nov 26 (Reuters) – Spain goes to the polls on Sunday in an early parliamentary election that may usher in a right-wing coalition to replace the Socialist-led minority government of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, one of Europe’s last leftist leaders. Sanchez called the election after parliament on October 2 rejected his decrees to address growing anger over rising rents and evictions.

stories.title: Who Is Vardhaman Jain? Chennai Businessman Offers 121 Kg Gold Ornaments Worth ₹206 Cr To Lord Venkateswara
stories.summary: Chennai-based industrialist and philanthropist Vardhaman Jain has made a significant religious contribution by donating 121 kg of gold ornaments valued at ₹160 crore to the Tirumala Temple in Andhra Pradesh. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu visited the temple on Thursday, Nov 26, to attend the formal handover ceremony.

stories.title: Why Are SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities Missing From Collegium Picks? Ex-CJI BR Gavai Flags Representation Gap
stories.summary: Former Chief Justice of India (CJI) BR Gavai has raised questions over alleged bias in recent Supreme Court collegium recommendations for judicial appointments and transfers, writing to President Droupadi Murmu on November 27, 2026, and calling for greater representation of marginalised communities in the higher judiciary.

stories.title: Can India’s Capital Markets Unlock The Viksit Bharat Dream? ICRA-ASSOCHAM Outlines Roadmap For Financial Growth
stories.summary: India’s capital markets are expected to play a pivotal role in financing the country’s transition towards a developed economy by 2047, with greater market depth, liquidity and institutional participation emerging as critical priorities, according to an ICRA-ASSOCHAM report released on Friday. The report highlighted the need for a more inclusive financial ecosystem capable of mobilising long-term investments and supporting sustainable economic growth .

stories.title: Rs 11-Lakh Chandelier, Rs 6-Lakh Temple: Inside Kejriwal’s Former ‘Sheesh Mahal’, Soon To Open To Public
stories.summary: After remaining the BJP's key criticism of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and its common man-friendly image, former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal's erstwhile official residence was opened for a media tour on Friday. Dubbed the 'Sheesh Mahal', the Kejriwal's former Flagstaff Road bungalow was used as ammunition by the BJP ahead of the Delhi Assembly election last year.

stories.title: Special Trains Being Run For Devotees Willing to Attend Kali Puja in Dakshin Dinajpur (West Bengal)
stories.summary: To facilitate ease of travel for devotees attending Bolla Kali Puja in Dakshin Dinajpur district of West Bengal, Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) will operate passenger special trains between New Coochbehar and Balurghat from 27th to 29th November 2026. NFR has also arranged two-minute stoppages at Eklakhi station under Katihar Division for four pairs of special trains on select journeys, giving devotees additional travel options during the puja.

stories.title: Aarti's defamation case against Kenisha: HC orders Dec 3 appearance
stories.summary: Ravi Mohan and Aarti are currently facing a series of legal battles amid their separation and pending divorce. Aarti's recent action involves a defamation case against singer Kenisha Francis, which is set for court hearing. Additionally, Aarti has requested that Ravi's visitation rights to their two sons be revoked, citing concerns over his behavior and unpaid maintenance fees.

stories.title: 'Deepam to be lit tomorrow': Furious SC suspends temple trust, asks CRPF to step in
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has mandated that a Karthigai Deepam lamp be lit atop Deepathoon, following the suspension of the temple's board of trustees and the appointment of receivers for management. Security responsibilities have been given to the CRPF for the temple and nearby hill. Moreover, the court issued contempt notices to several Tamil Nadu officials for non-compliance and cautioned against any actions that might threaten constitutional order.

stories.title: Viral VIDEO: Passenger Blows Conch, Lights Diya Inside AC Train Coach To Perform Pooja; Railways Seeks Details For Probe
stories.summary: A video showing a passenger performing puja inside an air-conditioned train coach has gone viral on social media, triggering concerns over passenger safety and the misuse of public transport spaces. The clip reportedly shows the passenger conducting religious rituals, lighting a diya (oil lamp) and blowing a conch inside the moving train.
